title: PuddingCoded's optimised purple pack
description: Additions to textures to make them stand out and help with visibility. or if ya just like purp
body:
This resource pack edits the textures of many items, particles and other visual effects to make them purple. Right now, there are only about 5 new textures. Howevere, leave suggestions on what items you would like to see next.

Why? I like purple.
